settings.title: Chat
settings.channel_ownership_members: Members create and manage their own channels
settings.channel_ownership_help: With members in charge, the permissions grid below splits into two blocks. "Chat: global" applies to the whole chat, in every channel. "Chat: channels run by members" applies only inside the channels members create and run: creating them, managing them, editing them, and what members may send in them. A channel's owner can promote members to moderators of that channel; owners and channel moderators skip its slow mode. Administrators and chat moderators keep every channel.
settings.allow_archiving_channels_help: A closed channel can be archived into a discussion that keeps its transcript.
settings.threading_default_help: New channels start with threads on. Each channel can still change it.
settings.retention_warning: Retention permanently deletes messages. There is no undo.
settings.channel_retention_help: Days to keep messages in category channels. 0 keeps them forever.
settings.dm_retention_help: Days to keep direct and group messages. 0 keeps them forever.
settings.max_messages_per_second: Maximum messages per second, per user
settings.max_messages_per_second_help: Sends above this rate are refused. 0 turns the limit off.
settings.max_message_length_help: The forum-wide limit. A channel can set a shorter one of its own.
settings.message_edit_window_help: How long an author may edit their message. 0 means no limit.
settings.allow_uploads_help: Attachments in messages. Which groups may attach is a permission below.
settings.upload_storage_help: Attachments in private channels, direct messages and restricted categories always stay on this forum's private disk, whatever is chosen here. If fof/upload cannot store a file, the upload is refused rather than kept locally.
settings.fof_upload_adapter_help: Which of FoF Upload's storage backends receives chat attachments. The bucket must be publicly readable. FoF Upload's own file types, size limits and permissions do not apply here; the chat's limits above and its upload permission do.
settings.fof_upload_adapter_mapping: Follow FoF Upload's file type mapping
settings.fof_upload_local_warning: FoF Upload's local adapter, which its file type mapping often picks, writes to public/assets/files on this server. That only saves bandwidth if a CDN URL is set in FoF Upload's settings.
settings.title_help: Shown on the header button and the drawer. Leave blank to use "Chat".
settings.icon_help: A Font Awesome class, e.g. fas fa-comments.
settings.bot_name_help: The author shown on messages the chat sends itself, such as new-discussion announcements.
settings.bot_avatar_help: A URL to the bot's picture. Left empty, its initial is shown instead.
settings.show_icon_help: Turn off to show only the name.
settings.threading_default: Enable threads on new channels by default
settings.queue_realtime: Deliver realtime events through the queue
settings.queue_realtime_help: Off by default: pushes run in the request, so messages arrive immediately. Turn this on only if your forum runs a continuous queue worker, or if the web server cannot reach the websocket daemon. With Flarum's database queue driver the worker runs once a minute, which will delay every message by up to that long.
settings.queue_realtime_inline: Realtime events are delivered within the request: this forum has no continuous queue worker, so routing them through the queue would only delay them.
settings.queue_realtime_inline_database: Realtime events are delivered within the request: Flarum's database queue is worked once a minute, so routing them through it would delay messages by up to a minute.
settings.sound_help: Played when a message arrives in a channel you are not looking at.
settings.webhooks_enabled_help: Off, every webhook URL is refused, whether or not the webhook itself is active. Saved with the rest of the page.
